classification.difficultyReason: Compare coefficients in the specified cosine form, select quadrant III and solve the resulting cosine equation on the given domain.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Express $-3\sin x-4\cos x$ in the form $S\cos(x-\beta)$, where $S>0$ and $0<\beta<2\pi$. Write $\beta$ correct to four decimal places.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}-3\sin x-4\cos x&=S\cos x\cos\beta+S\sin x\sin\beta\\S\cos\beta&=-4\\S\sin\beta&=-3\\S^2(\cos^2\beta+\sin^2\beta)&=(-4)^2+(-3)^2\\S&=5\quad(S>0)\\\tan\beta&=\frac34\end{aligned}$$
Since $\cos\beta<0$ and $\sin\beta<0$, $\beta$ is in quadrant III.
$$\begin{aligned}\beta&=\pi+\tan^{-1}\left(\frac34\right)\\\beta&\approx3.7851\end{aligned}$$
Thus $-3\sin x-4\cos x=5\cos(x-\beta)$, with $\beta\approx3.7851$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Hence solve $-3\sin x-4\cos x=2$, for $0\le x<2\pi$. Give the solutions correct to two decimal places.

answer.worked:
Using $\beta=\pi+\tan^{-1}\left(\frac34\right)$ without rounding,
$$\begin{aligned}5\cos(x-\beta)&=2\\\cos(x-\beta)&=0.4\\x-\beta&=\pm\cos^{-1}(0.4)\\x&=\pi+\tan^{-1}\left(\frac34\right)\pm\cos^{-1}(0.4)\\x&\approx2.63\text{ or }4.94\end{aligned}$$
Both solutions lie in $0\le x<2\pi$.
